name: useBLE
summary: Bluetooth adapter state, Channel Sounding, bonded devices, and active BLE peripheral discovery.
plain: Reports whether Bluetooth is on, which devices are already paired, whether this phone declares Channel Sounding, and performs live peripheral discovery with real RSSI values and a derived distance estimate.
description: Adapter state and the bonded device list are read from Android BluetoothAdapter through the native module (useRadios); channelSounding is whether the device declares the android.hardware.bluetooth_le.channel_sounding feature, and ranging a peer is useChannelSounding. Live peripheral discovery uses Android BluetoothLeScanner: each peripheral has its address (results without an address are skipped), name (null when neither BluetoothDevice.getName() nor the advertised local name is available), RSSI in dBm, lastSeenTimestamp (wall-clock ms computed from ScanResult.getTimestampNanos() against SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()) and estimatedDistanceMeters. The distance is derived, not measured: log-distance path loss with an assumed -59 dBm at 1 m and exponent 2. A failed scan (ScanCallback.onScanFailed) is reported in scanError with its code.

returns.name: isSupported
returns.desc: Whether the device has Bluetooth Low Energy.

returns.name: isEnabled
returns.desc: Whether Bluetooth is switched on in settings.

returns.name: state
returns.desc: Adapter state, including the transitional values.

returns.name: channelSounding
returns.desc: Whether the device declares android.hardware.bluetooth_le.channel_sounding. Ranging itself is in useChannelSounding.

returns.name: bondedDevices
returns.desc: Devices already paired with this phone; name is null when unnamed or BLUETOOTH_CONNECT is not granted.

returns.name: isScanning
returns.desc: Whether a BLE scan is running.

returns.name: peripherals
returns.desc: Discovered nearby BLE peripherals: id (address), name (or null), RSSI in dBm, lastSeenTimestamp (wall-clock ms) and a derived distance estimate.

returns.name: scanError
returns.desc: Why the scan could not start or failed, including the ScanCallback.onScanFailed error code.

returns.name: source
returns.desc: Where the numbers came from. There is no 'simulated' value: a reading is real, derived from real readings, or unavailable.

returns.name: error
returns.desc: Latest adapter-level failure message. Failures are also logged and counted.

actions.name: startScan(timeoutMs?)
actions.desc: Begins physical Bluetooth Low Energy discovery through BluetoothLeScanner.

inputs.name: timeoutMs
inputs.desc: How long to scan before stopping automatically, in milliseconds. Defaults to 10000.

actions.output: Resolves true when the scan started; false with the reason in scanError otherwise. Results appear in peripherals, polled every 500 ms; an asynchronous scan failure ends the scan and sets scanError.

actions.name: stopScan()
actions.desc: Stops active BLE discovery and clears the auto-stop timer.
actions.output: Returns nothing; a final results sync runs first, so nothing already discovered is lost.

agentNote: BLE scanning uses Android BluetoothLeScanner. Call startScan with a finite timeout to preserve battery. Treat estimatedDistanceMeters as a rough proximity figure: it assumes -59 dBm at 1 m.
